faq.question: Which are the top universities for Master's in Engineering in Finland?
faq.answer: Aalto University, Tampere University, LUT University, University of Oulu, University of Turku, and Åbo Akademi University are Finland's top-ranked institutions offering English-taught M.Sc. Tech degrees.

faq.question: Is GRE required for Master's in Engineering in Finland?
faq.answer: No. Most Finnish technical universities do not mandate GRE examination scores. Admissions are evaluated based on your bachelor's degree grades, academic background, and English language proficiency.

faq.question: Can I work in Finland during and after my Master's degree?
faq.answer: Yes. International students can work up to 30 hours per week during semesters and full-time during breaks. Graduates can also apply for a two-year post-study job seeker residence permit in Finland.
